title: Endoscopic liftings and parameters of epipelagic representations for classical groups
summary: Let $G$ be a $p$-adic classical group (orthogonal, symplectic, or unitary) and $π$ be an epipelagic representation of $G$ in the sense of Reeder-Yu. Using Mœglin's theory of extended cuspidal supports and Bushnell-Kutzko's theory of covering types, we determine explicitly the endoscopic lift of $π$ to the general linear group, whose Langlands dual expresses the dual group of $G$ as a complex matrix group, in terms of the inducing type of $π$ that extends the character of the first Moy-Prasad filtration subgroup defined by a stable functional.
